results.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
results.overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.

results.title: Gauthali
results.overview: Child bride Gauthali overcomes abuse, loss, and discrimination through the power of education. Her determination to reclaim her future challenges deep-rooted traditions inspiring to stand against gender inequality.

results.title: Father's Day
results.overview: On the verge of fatherhood, Sushant learns his estranged father is alive. Hoping to reconnect, he sets out on a one-day motorcycle ride through rural Karnataka to meet the man who once abandoned him. What follows is a journey of discovery, bonding, and unforgettable moments, an emotional ride that comes once in a lifetime.

results.title: Hope

But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

results.title: The Odyssey
results.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

results.title: Portrait of Grief
results.overview: A small excerpt from the scenes of a complicated relationship between a mother and her daughter.

results.title: Mother Promise
results.overview: A gambler loses everything in Bengaluru and flees from dons, smugglers, and misfits while his own mother joins the pursuit. A riotous comedy about chaos, family, and the one promise even the toughest men dare not break.

results.overview: The relentless rat race of life, exploring the struggles and ambitions of individuals navigating the complexities of their modern existence.

results.overview: Eight men abandon their duties for a booze-fueled mountain getaway, but supernatural forces in the remote wild distort their reality, straining friendships and driving each man to his limit.

results.title: Moana
results.overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

results.title: What The Land Remembers
results.overview: The Tharu people are the indigenous community of the Chitwan region, part of Nepal’s Terai lowlands. They proudly identify as "The People of the Forest," reflecting their historical and ongoing connection to the natural environment. This immersive, dialogue-guided film follows Asma Ram Mahto, 84, as he navigates the growing thresholds between himself and the forest of his home. The film’s emotional core lies in Aasma Ram’s quiet determination to remember and guard the old wisdom passed to the community and to listen to the land’s fading whispers before they’re gone forever.

results.title: Love Seasons
results.overview: Revolves around Trust as a powerful force connects people while love quietly grows around it.

results.title: Graamaayana
results.overview: In a rustic village, young Seena earns his "Sixth Sense" nickname through remarkable intuition. His journey through community conflicts, romantic entanglements, and family bonds reveals the essence of rural existence.

results.title: CHANCE
results.overview: An unforeseen incident transforms A young man’s outlook on life, making him realize that depending on himself is the key, and that life becomes magical only when he chooses to be the magician.

results.title: Maya Ko Dori Le
results.overview: A story of love, relationships, and the bonds that connect us all.

results.title: Sapsu: A Solemn Promise
results.overview: In a small remote village, an 80-year-old man dies. Seventeen people from the village go together to attend his funeral. While traveling through a thick mist, all 17 mourners suddenly disappear. They never return to the village.

results.title: A Mother's Embrace
results.overview: An old, ailing mother, devises a simple yet ingenious way to sustain herself with a bucket and a rope. But when news of looming deportations in America shakes her fragile world, she turns to the same lifeline in a desperate attempt to reach her undocumented son, hoping that across borders, across silence, a mother’s embrace can still be felt.

results.title: Chadani
results.overview: In the quiet village of Bardiya, 24-year-old Chadani Thapa cuts hair for men, a job rarely held by women in her community. Living away from her family for the past two years, she has built a life shaped by routine, resilience, and a growing sense of independence. As she sharpens her skills in a male-dominated trade, the emotional distance from her loved ones lingers in the background. Through everyday moments and silences, this documentary traces Chadani’s journey, not just as a barber, but as a young woman quietly carving out space for herself in a world that offers little of it. Her solitude becomes a landscape for reflection, and her work, a quiet rebellion.

results.title: In the Shadow of the Bamboo Basket
results.overview: Through the eyes of a 13-year-old boy, Doko Ko Chahari explores the fragile boundary between childhood innocence and imagination as fear, poverty, and a haunting folktale shape his journey toward understanding the value of education and reality.

results.title: Balaramana Dinagalu
results.overview: Balarama, an ordinary young man from a remote village in Karnataka, becomes a dreaded gangster who rules Bangalore. Set in 1980s Bangalore, it tells a gripping story of nostalgia, power, passion, love, and betrayal.

results.title: Moda Kavida Vaathavarana
results.overview: Moda Kavida Vaatavarana is a youthful romantic thriller centered around two couples who arrive at a scenic resort, each carrying their own emotional baggage and untold stories. As relationships are tested and unexpected connections emerge, a series of mysterious events unfold, leading to suspense, romance, humor, and surprising twists that change their lives forever.

results.title: Jaand
results.overview: A guy sick of having only daughters toxic himself everyday with alcohol only to tear his family more than ever.

results.title: Eat Me Stupid
results.overview: A singer song writer frustrated with her music wandered through the city of Darjeeling in search of inspiration.

results.title: Minions & Monsters
results.overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

results.title: I am Jit Bahadur
results.overview: Jit Bahadur’s journey from a struggling dreamer to a celebrated actor reveals the harsh price of fame, as his relentless ambition gradually distances him from the very family that once supported him.

results.title: Toy Story 5
results.overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

results.title: Hunter's Moon
results.overview: After a successful season in the Upper Dhauladhar Mountains, a hunter hides his meat in a cave and heads home with his first load. At home, his wife is upset over his prolonged absence and its impact on their disabled daughter. He promises to return quickly and the next morning, sets out to retrieve the rest of the meat and leave the forest for the season. To his dismay, he finds the cave empty and the meat stolen. Using his hunter instincts he launches a desperate search through the  treacherous mountain, discovering that the rival is just as cunning. In this quest for meat, humans behave no differently than wild animals. Battling harsh conditions and difficult terrains, they go to all extremes to prove themselves stronger and more deserving. This allegorical tale of conflicting morals and twisted values reveals the true nature of man in the wild.

results.title: Shadows of the Past
results.overview: In the aftermath of her father’s tragic suicide, Sahana and her mother grapple with grief and the question of why he took his own life to which she starts experiencing a series of chilling and inexplicable events, blurring the line between reality and supernatural forces.

results.title: Huli Jeevagalu
results.overview: Suri, a reclusive man, attempts to reconnect with his grandmother through her favourite recipe, only to run into unexpected visitors.

results.title: Mruthyudevate
results.overview: According to Hindu mythology, the God of Death is Lord Dharmaraya, the one who delivers justice and punishment for a person's deeds after their lifetime ends. But the "Goddess of Death" in this film is not about fate or the end of life.

results.title: Disclosure Day
results.overview: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.

results.title: College Kalavida
results.overview: Two students share an unspoken love, waiting for the perfect moment to confess. Destiny separates them before they can. Years later, their paths cross again. Will they finally speak their hearts, or let the moment slip away once more?

results.title: Mango Pachcha

results.title: Redemption Song
results.overview: A former Gurkha soldier is losing his grip on reality as he lives in self-imposed isolation in the UK.

results.title: Unreachables
results.overview: Bishal decides to meet his friend, Mausam, one last time, before leaving Nepal. While sharing a drink, they talk about their life and family. They reminisce about their past and ponder over their uncertain futures. Both are not ready for new beginnings. As Bishal prepares to leave, Mausam stays with remnants of his past.

results.title: I Listen for the Sound of Ashes
results.original_title: I Listen for the Sound of Ashes
results.overview: I Listen for the Sound of Ashes unfolds through recorded phone conversations between the filmmaker and his parents during a period of political unrest in Nepal. As they speak about fear, memory, and everyday life, the screen holds quiet American landscapes: mountains, clouds, empty fields — places that feel still while everything back home feels unsettled. The film is about distance, but more than that, it’s about relationships: between a son and his parents, between diaspora and homeland, between safety and responsibility. It asks what happens to identity when you live far away from the place that shaped you, and how connection survives across that distance.

results.title: I Will Be Back with a Pen
results.original_title: I Will Be Back with a Pen
results.overview: A meditative documentary about a forgotten railway project in eastern Nepal where stories linger in places shaped by memory and loss.

results.title: The Breadwinner
results.overview: After his wife Katie lands a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank that takes her on a prolonged business trip - lifelong breadwinner Nate Wilcox now has to fend for his family as a first-time stay-at-home dad.

results.title: Lakhey
results.overview: When a cursed beggar summons the demon Lakhey, reckless gambler Ram must outrun fate itself, gambling his soul for one last chance to deliver his daughter’s birthday cake.

results.title: Shape of Momo
results.overview: Bishnu returns to her Himalayan village after quitting her job, only to face mounting family pressures and societal expectations. As tensions rise with her pregnant sister's arrival and a budding relationship with a "suitable" boy from her community, Bishnu must choose between conforming to tradition or claiming her independence.

results.title: Roll No. 1
results.overview: A story of a boy struggling to fulfill his father's dream of winning a scholarship from the government.

results.title: Kumbh
results.overview: The high-stakes Nepali action-thriller that follows a gritty protagonist named Raghu as he asserts his dominance and confronts enemies in a world defined by conflict and power struggles

results.title: My Mum is a Bodybuilder
results.overview: Set in the tradition-bound city of Bhaktapur, within a Newar household, the film follows a 42-year-old mother pursuing bodybuilding while navigating societal expectations in Nepal. Told through the perspective of her two sons who also serve as co-authors and cinematographers, it traces their journey of documenting her life, only to discover a new way of seeing her beyond the role of a mother, while also revealing the rigid expectations imposed by society.

results.title: Mokshyam
results.overview: A businessman struggles to fix a deal for his startup while attending a temple ritual, thus ignoring his religious wife and their daughter, who leave heartbroken, after he aggressively rages at them. Meanwhile, a mysterious ascetic stalks them everywhere. When the businessman receives shocking news, an astonishing connection between him and the ascetic is revealed.

results.title: Colors of Evening
results.overview: An 11-year-old city boy sets out to buy alcohol for his father at the command of his mother.

results.title: I Have Become a Rhododendron
results.overview: Maiya Devi Pandey, a 70-year-old Nepali woman and her grandson, bond over and discover each other through football.

results.title: September 21

results.title: Colony

results.title: Lo Naveena
results.overview: A rustic village boy and his wild friends embark on a chaotic, heartwarming quest to win the heart of his beloved Asha.

results.overview: In the early 1970s, a petty criminal Kaali unwittingly involves himself with underworld thugs, catalyzing events beyond his control.

results.title: Dynamo
results.overview: Rocky, a second year student plans a wild dance to impress the whole college. Rajahuli, the dominant final year student, sees this as a challenge to his authority. A fierce clash brews between Rocky's ambition and Rajahuli's control.

results.title: Elra Kaaleliyatte Kaala
results.overview: Elra Kaaleliyatte Kaala follows Vijay, who gets stranded in the unusual village of Idnodu, where life moves without clocks and time feels suspended. As he tries to leave, he is drawn into its rhythm, gradually confronting the tension between urgency and stillness.

results.title: Peter
results.overview: Set against the misty green landscapes of Madikeri and Bhagamandala, Peter is a gripping suspense drama that delves into secrets, crimes, and human emotions that refuse to stay buried. It's an edge-of-your-seat suspense drama that unravels mystery, emotions, and shocking truths in the heart of Coorg's haunting beauty. Peter takes you on an unforgettable, suspenseful journey where love, crime, and betrayal collide.

results.title: Claws and Teeth
results.overview: Ananya goes boar hunting with his cousin Giri and a mute plantation worker, Kaada. They accidentally kill a tiger and decide to smuggle its claws and skin. To avoid forest patrols on their way home, Anayya instructs Kaada to take a different route. However, Kaada is caught by forest guards. Ananya, to ensure his own safety, denies being with Kaada when Kaada’s son seeks help for his father's release. The story unfolds as Ananya struggles to retrieve the claws and faces the man he once looked down upon, leading to a reversal of power dynamics between the two.

results.title: Sacrifice
results.overview: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires, and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

results.title: Nanu Karunakara
results.overview: A struggling assistant director in the Kannada film industry battles personal pride and financial hardship as he tries to grant his young son's wish for a toy car, only to face choices that test his self-worth, family bonds, and deepest dreams.

results.title: Project Hail Mary

As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

results.title: War of the Worlds
results.overview: Will Radford is a top analyst for Homeland Security who tracks potential threats through a mass surveillance program, until one day an attack by an unknown entity leads him to question whether the government is hiding something from him... and from the rest of the world.

results.title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
results.original_title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
results.overview: Once the booming home of pharmaceutical giant Umbrella Corporation, Raccoon City is now a dying Midwestern town. The company’s exodus left the city a wasteland…with great evil brewing below the surface. When that evil is unleashed, the townspeople are forever…changed…and a small group of survivors must work together to uncover the truth behind Umbrella and make it through the night.

results.title: Trolls World Tour

results.title: Avengers: Endgame
results.overview: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

results.title: Avengers: Infinity War
results.overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.

results.title: Interstellar
results.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

But as Christmas approaches, Jack's rag-doll girlfriend, Sally, tries to foil his misguided plans.

results.title: Premada Oorali
results.overview: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.
